# Case/data description: Center for Victims of Torture 

The Center for Victims of Torture is a US-based non-profit organisation that provides healing care to torture survivors and advocates for human rights: <https://www.cvt.org>

Besides information on its programs, CVT publishes articles written by its staff and experts. Some of them are presented in the category *Expert Voices*.

Your task is to scrape the *Expert Voices* page(s). 

**If you think that scraping the page is not legal, do not scrape it and explain why you think this is the case.**

**Question 2.** Explain in your own words what the function does and comment every single line with #. *(max. 300 words)*.

```{r}
get_text = function(blog_post_link){
  Sys.sleep(12)                       
  blog_post_page = read_html(blog_post_link)
  blog_post_text = blog_post_page %>%
    html_nodes("p") %>%             
    html_text(trim = TRUE) %>%
    paste(collapse = " ")         
  return(blog_post_text)
}
```

*Answer*:
